dataRecordMapping.description:
Provides a mapping from a data record returned by an api call, which may be in any shape,
to the shape required by the concrete data spec setting type implementation.

fieldName.description: The name of the field to which these settings apply

fillColor.description: Fill with a static color. HTML color name 'gray' => '#808080'

directionConfig.description:
Configuration that controls if and how edges are directed.
Edges can either appear as bidirectional, unidirectional, unidirectional (reverse), or undirected.

sizeByProperty.description:
A numerical property that, when specified, dictates how links are sized. Takes precedence over
{@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationEdgeStyleConfig#size}.

isDotted.description:
The name of the link property which, when evaluated, will determine if the line is solid or dotted:
true -> dotted, false -> solid.

labelText.description:
The link property used to populate the label of an edge. If unspecified, there will be no label.
If a given link doesn't have the specified property, the label will be blank.

fromNodeEndLabelText.description: The link property used to populate the label of an edge, close to the from node end. If unspecified, there will be no label.

toNodeEndLabelText.description: The link property used to populate the label of an edge, close to the to node end. If unspecified, there will be no label.

fillColorOnHover.description: Color to apply to the edge when hovered

widthOnHover.description: Width to apply to the edge when hovered

flowConfig.description: The configuration for the flow animation on an edge.

title: Type defining the configuration for how an edge should be styled.
name: UiSdlGraphVisualizationEdgeStyleConfig
